title: Clustering Discourses: Racial Biases in Short Stories about Women Generated by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompted an LLM to generate short stories in Portuguese about Black and white women, both with and without specific names. The generated stories were encoded into feature vectors and grouped using DBSCAN clustering. The researchers then conducted a mixed-methods qualitative discourse and lexical analysis (using word/adjective clouds and discursive sequences) on the clusters to compare narrative portrayals across racial identities.
